summary: Keep TUI terminal attach results scoped to the selected attempt and offer Ctrl+R retry after a 100-second attach deadline.

replay.detail: Only process-local TUI attach state changes; no event replay changes.

schema.detail: No database or persisted state changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or member coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: No wire or client capability changes; existing attach requests are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No daemon restart or additional service interruption is required.

manual.detail: No migration steps. A terminal that times out now shows a failed status and Ctrl+R retry hint.

recovery.detail: No persistent state is modified; replacing the TUI binary needs no data recovery.
